user.title: Configure ADS1115 Device
user.description: Set up your ADS1115 ADC sensor. Make sure I2C is enabled on your system.

select_channels.title: Select Channels
select_channels.description: Select which analog input channels to monitor on {device}.

data_description.measurement_type: Single-ended: measure voltage relative to GND. Differential: measure voltage difference between two channels.
data_description.differential_pair: Select which two channels to use for differential measurement. Ignored if Single-ended is selected.
data_description.multiplier: Multiply the measured voltage by this factor. Useful for voltage dividers (e.g., battery monitoring).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to ADS1115. Check I2C bus number and address.
error.permission_denied: Permission denied accessing I2C. Run: sudo usermod -a -G i2c $USER
error.unknown: Unknown error occurred. Check logs for details.
error.no_channels: Please select at least one channel.

abort.already_configured: This ADS1115 device is already configured.
